description: 32 points (9 in Jamaica, 23 in Haiti) where Planetary Response Network volunteers on the Zooniverse platform identified road blockages, bridge damage, flooding, coastal damage or debris on PlanetScope 3 m imagery after Hurricane Melissa, as published on HDX on 2025-12-12 (file names dated 02_11_25; HDX dataset date 2025-11-02 to 2025-11-04). The publisher's attributes are kept (Damage class, Location for Jamaica, image_id for Haiti); country and source_file are derived. Roads categorised: Jamaica motorway/primary/secondary, Haiti primary/secondary/tertiary. A consensus of twelve volunteers, checked against imagery by an expert, not a ground survey. Source: Jamaica and Haiti - Hurricane Melissa Road Blockages (HDX), retrieved 2026-09-23.
